snippet.title: Devil Jam - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist Now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3461800

Get Ready to Riff Your Way to the Top of Hell's Stardom.
Rogueside is proud to announce Devil Jam, a hand-drawn visuals, Metal-themed survivor-like with beat-driven combat set in Hell. The game offers a unique 12-slot inventory system, allowing for near-infinite demonic builds.

Devil Jam launches in 2025 on PC, Xbox Series X|S, PlayStation 5 and Nintendo Switch.

Follow us on X:   https://x.com/RoguesideGames
Join the Official Discord:   https://discord.com/invite/eqHWSff
